description: This file defines the AccessPointArn class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling access point ARNs, including parsing, validation, and retrieval of the access point name.

classes.name: AccessPointArn
classes.description: Represents an AWS specific ARN for an access point, providing methods for parsing, validation, and retrieving the access point name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AccessPointArn object, initializing data and performing validation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method to parse an ARN string into its component data, including resource type and ID.

methods.name: getAccesspointName
methods.description: Returns the access point name extracted from the ARN data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ARN data specific to access points, including checks on resource type and ID.
